failures.observed: Driver-death test fails in 5.63s total, shorter than its six-second termination deadline. Native exit receipt records signal 9 and driver disappeared. Therefore the empty-group condition broke the wait before the separate sameProcess assertion. The PID is absent at subsequent inspection; exact transient kernel process state was not captured in that failed run.
failures.correction: Wait for both cgroup empty/missing and the same process identity gone within the unchanged six-second deadline. Retain timestamped process/cgroup observations. No production process-kill code changed.
failures.diagnosticProof: Five successful instrumented repetitions before correction; no claim that these reproduced the failing window.
failures.finalProof: driver-death-final-01: five actual driver kills, five descendant terminations, candidate interruption costs retained.
